content:
I've been on the hunt for ultra-thin accessories to complement my everyday carry, and I'm always paying attention to how thin major tech companies and brands can make their products. I typically avoid accessories that are too bulky and lack thoughtful storage design. As a result, I've tried countless accessories—from power banks to stands to magnetic cables. I want to share some of my favorites that are not only ultra-thin and portable but also packed with features.

Be sure to check out our hands-on video, which showcases all the devices mentioned in this article and more. The video features 11 slim and lightweight accessories worth knowing about!

This is a new addition to my EDC, and it has been performing exceptionally well. It's incredible how they packed so much functionality into such a slim device. It's roughly the same thickness as the iPhone's camera module. Key features include:

  • Popsocket-style grip ring for single or double finger use
  • Built-in adjustable metal kickstand with 350-degree rotation
  • Supports both portrait and landscape orientations
  • Dual-sided magnetic design, meaning you can stack more MagSafe accessories on top of the stand

To this day, I still can't figure out how they managed to cram so much functionality into such a slim and lightweight stand, but it has become a permanent fixture on my iPhone. It's so thin that you can still wirelessly charge through it! Another great benefit—because it's so thin, it actually solves the wobble problem when you lay your phone flat on a table!

The Snap Grip Stand is available on their official website for $39.99 USD, available in black, green, light purple, and silver. They also sell the grip ring component separately for $29.99 USD in 18 colors (too many to count). Highly recommended for any iPhone user.

This is my timeless favorite. On the surface, it looks like just another 3-in-1 Apple charger, but what truly sets it apart is its build quality, functionality, and value. You get:

  • Qi2.2 25W MagSafe-compatible charger
  • 5W Apple Watch charger
  • 5W AirPods charger
  • Foldable CNC aluminum design

This product is incredibly slim and lightweight. The Kuxiu X40 Turbo can fold down to charge just your iPhone, unfold into a 3-in-1 charging stand, or lay completely flat. At its thinnest point, it's only 18mm, and when folded, you can hold it with one hand. The best part is that it comes with the 45W power adapter needed for 25W fast charging, plus a hardshell carrying case for all the accessories. This product is truly underrated.

The Kuxiu X40 Turbo is available on the Kuxiu website for $78 USD, available in gray, black, wood grain, orange, and cherry red. It's the first charger on the market that perfectly matches the cosmic orange iPhone! For $78 USD, you get not just the charger, but also a braided cable, 45W power adapter, and carrying case.

But wait, there's more. I'm a strong advocate for ultra-thin magnetic power banks. High-capacity MagSafe power banks have their uses, but if I want to use my phone while charging, I prefer a smaller-capacity power bank that can give my phone a little boost without turning it into a two-pound brick. So far, the thinnest and lightest MagSafe power bank is the SolidSafe Air. Its specs include:

  • 5,000mAh battery capacity
  • Ultra-thin 6.8mm body
  • Qi2 wireless charging support up to 15W
  • USB-C output charging up to 20W
  • Can charge two devices simultaneously

I bought three of these power banks, and I always carry at least one wherever I go. My iPhone 17 Pro can't last a full day anymore, so having one of these is essential for me. They're lightweight, look and feel premium, and come in a great selection of colors.

The SolidSafe Air 5K is available on the BMX website for $59 USD, available in black, silver, and gold. You can also buy a 2-pack or 3-pack to save some money. My only request for the next generation is to replace the LED indicator with a small screen—just as long as it doesn't add any thickness!

This product is perfect for iPhone users who love taking photos with their phone, or anyone who wants a portable fill light. The SnapPocket is a small, lightweight ring light that magnetically attaches to the back of your phone. It can also flip to the front, so you get beautiful fill light when using the front-facing camera. Features include:

  • Built-in 8 LED lights
  • Maximum brightness of 90 lumens
  • 4 adjustable brightness levels
  • Flip design, MagSafe compatible
  • Built-in rechargeable battery with USB-C charging

Looking at the specs, the SnapPocket is twice as bright as the iPhone's built-in flash and provides a more stable light source, which is especially useful for video recording. Like other accessories, the key focus of this product is portability and lightweight design. It can fit in any pocket or bag, and since it's MagSafe compatible, you can leave it attached to your phone all day.

The ShiftCam SnapPocket Light is available on Amazon, and you can use the promo code on the product page to get it for $33 USD. Available in black, blue, and gray. For anyone looking to improve their iPhone photography quality without spending a lot of money or dealing with complicated setups, this product is the perfect gift.

I've mentioned this product before, but I use it so often that I want to bring it up again. Everyone knows SSD prices are getting increasingly ridiculous, but buying an external SSD is still much cheaper than paying to upgrade your iPhone's internal storage. So when I want to record ProRes video, I always use my Lexar ES5 SSD. It magnetically attaches to the phone, has a built-in USB-C cable, and can record directly to the SSD without taking up your iPhone's storage. Here are the specs:

  • Read/write speeds up to 2,000MB/s
  • Supports USB 3.2 Gen 2×2 connectivity
  • Supports direct ProRes recording up to 4K/120fps
  • IP65 protection rating, withstands 3-meter drops
  • Maximum capacity of 4TB

Its size is another reason I use it more than other SSDs. It's small and lightweight, with slightly rounded edges that make it more comfortable to hold when you're holding your phone.

The Lexar ES5 is available on Amazon, with the 1TB version starting at $199 USD. While it's more expensive than a few months ago, it's still much cheaper than buying an iPhone with 1TB of internal storage.

Conclusion

As mentioned above, be sure to watch our video, where I showcase 11 slim and lightweight products guaranteed to suit your taste. The five listed above are just my personal picks. My philosophy is to travel as light as possible, and these accessories perfectly fit my needs. From the ultra-thin, multi-functional Snap Grip Stand to the extremely practical Lexar SSD, each one does its job without forcing me to lug around bulky accessories.

What do you think of these accessories? Have you used any of them? What's your favorite accessory in this category? Drop a comment and let's discuss.
